notes.title: Kamikaze Veggies In The Full Version!
notes.notes:
Dear Friends!

We are pleased to announce that, after more than two years of development, "Kamikaze Veggies" is now available in full on Steam. Our game consists of 12 missions that will put your dexterity, stealth, patience, and logical thinking skills to the test! If you don't abandon ship, you'll be rewarded with an unforgettable adventure, 7 - 10 hours of gameplay, and a story as bizarre as we managed to create! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617003/9dbd936a36447b276e26edd0668141e87fffb9d8.png[/img]



Cheers!
Red Limb Studio

notes.title: We are changing the name of our game!
notes.notes:
Dear Friends! 

After more than a year of working on "Suicide Vegetables", we are changing the name of our game!
YouTube's rules are becoming more stringent, and creators have to pay attention to the ever-increasing list of censored words. Recently, the list of "forbidden words" has been expanded to include the word "suicide", putting our production at too great a risk.

Our studio form 4 people. For independent game developers like us, working with influencers is a symbiosis. These two branches of the gaming industry are mutually reinforcing. Information that YouTubers won't publish content about your game is a disaster.  In our case, the appearance of the word "suicide" on the list had a domino effect that forced the name of the game to be changed. 

[b]We don't give up![/b]  We love dark humor, but sticking to the old name would be suicide for us. ( I just had to put this joke here 😈)  


On the final lap, we proudly present our new, revised title! [b]Kamikaze Veggies [/b] is a stealth adventure game with an absurd driven-story and third-person perspective for single-player or co-op. The Early Access game will be released in Q1 2022 for PC, and the full version will also be available on consoles!


 "What doesn't kill you makes you stronger"

Howgh ✊

Jacek /  Red Limb Studio

notes.title: Q&A
notes.notes:
[h2]Q&A[/h2]

1.[b]When is the game released?[/b]
Our game in the early access version will be released in January 2022.
2.[b]How much will the game cost?[/b] 
The early access version of the game will cost $6.99. The full version of the game will cost $9.99.
3.[b]How long is "Suicide Vegetables" gameplay?[/b]
The duration of the game in the early access version is about 3 hours. The full version takes about 5 hours.
4.[b]Will the game also be available on consoles? which ones?[/b]
Yes, our game will also be available on Nintendo Switch.
5.[b]What are your development plans after the game's release in early access?[/b]
We would like to invite players to work together to create the full version of the game. We would like to implement players' ideas into the game's plot and the process of creating new missions.
